FreybergerRai2018UniformBands: taut-band optimization is restricted to its nonrandom-shape class; EvansHansenStark2005MinimaxConfidence uses additive expected measure, not curve-diameter loss.
LeCamYang2000 supplies general experiment-comparison machinery, but no located compact-local Gaussian--Wishart deficiency transfer preserving this moving-KKT curve loss.
CanenSong2026SimplexWeight and FreybergerRai2018UniformBands do not establish sharp local minimax expected maximum curve width for unrestricted randomized panel bands.

novelty_flags.one_line: FreybergerRai2018UniformBands does not state or establish optimized average-width and maximum-width objectives as claimed: its concrete sufficient conditions and worked optimization are for weighted area, while its class excludes random selection among valid bands.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 121, Definition 1; p. 122, Section 2.3; p. 124, Theorem 2 and discussion immediately following it
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Definition 1 restricts the paper to bands whose inducing set has nonrandom shape and expressly rules out randomly selecting among valid bands. Section 2.3 identifies weighted area as the leading objective; Theorem 2 is conditional on a generic objective approximation, and the paper gives low-level sufficient conditions specifically for weighted area.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace every Freyberger--Rai comparison with its exact restricted-class result: nonrandom-shape taut bands and weighted-area approximation; state unrestricted external randomization and curve-diameter loss as the precise departure.

Add a short theorem-level separation from the restricted taut-band class, ideally an explicit KKT-curve instance where the unrestricted randomized decision value is strictly below every admissible nonrandom-shape taut-band value.

Prioritize the parameter-independent Gaussian--Wishart deficiency construction, including a coverage-deficit repair lemma for bounded curve-diameter loss; this is the required bridge from the Gaussian decision value to the observed panel.

recommended_next_step: Revise the Freyberger--Rai characterization, then retain this field-tier kernel for Stage 0 with the Gaussian--Wishart transfer as the central solve target.
